title: Report Lost Luggage
description: Report missing luggage at the airport
initialPrompt: Добрый день! Служба розыска багажа. Что случилось?
systemPrompt: You are airport lost luggage staff. Get flight number, bag description, contact info. Say you'll call when found. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User gave flight number and bag description, you took their contact info.
hints: Мой багаж не прилетел (My luggage didn't arrive)
